_note: TeamXT v1.7-aligned Apify actor configs. Niche 2 whitelist widened to full AI/agentic engineering (incl. ML Engineer, MLOps) per doc; Niche 1 Databricks/Snowflake data engineering added as parallel bundle. Two opposite recency windows: Just Funded wants FRESH roles; Stale Requirement wants ROLES OPEN 30+ DAYS (the staleness IS the trigger).

C1_just_funded_fresh_signal._purpose: Just Funded campaign. Series A-C round in last 90 days + fresh Niche1/Niche2 hiring. US, UK, Europe. Tiers T2A-T2B only.

C4_stale_requirement_unfilled_signal._purpose: Stale Requirement campaign - the HIGHEST CONVERTING cold motion per doc. Trigger is the OPPOSITE of freshness: a role open 30+ days means the client already failed to fill it. Do NOT exclude stale jobs here - that IS the target. Europe/UK T2A-T4, US T2A-T3A.
C4_stale_requirement_unfilled_signal._post_filter_required: Manually filter output where days_open >= 30 (actor has no native 'minimum age' input - postedWithinDays only sets a MAX window). Sort ascending by newest_posting_at to surface the stalest first.

C2_contract_probe._purpose: Secondary probe for contract/contract-to-hire language - useful for Individual Augmentation sells across all campaigns.

C3_stack_evidence_per_account._purpose: Per-account tech-stack evidence pass, run once at qualification. Confirms Niche1/Niche2 fit and feeds outreach personalization (profile snapshot matching).
